description: This file contains server-side load function and actions related to creating a new invoice in a SvelteKit application. It handles data fetching for form dropdowns and processes form submissions to create invoices via API requests.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads necessary data for the new invoice page, including accounts, contacts, and templates. Handles errors and ensures organization context exists.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles form submission to create a new invoice. Validates input, constructs invoice data, and sends API request to create invoice.
